using namespace std;

const int MAX_N = 1000111;
const long long MOD = 1000000007;

long long visited[MAX_N];
long long countArr[MAX_N];

long long modPow(long long base, long long exp) {
    if (exp == 0) return 1;
    long long half = modPow(base, exp / 2);
    long long result = (half * half) % MOD;
    if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << modPow(p, p - 1) << '\n';
        return 0;
    }
    if (k == 1) {
        cout << modPow(p, p) << '\n';
        return 0;
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i < p; i++) {
        if (visited[i]) continue;
        long long current = i;
        long long cycleLength = 0;
        
        while (!visited[current]) {
            visited[current] = 1;
            current = (current * k) % p;
            cycleLength++;
        }
        
        countArr[cycleLength]++;
    }
    
    long long answer = 1;
    for (int len = 1; len <= p - 1; len++) {
        if (countArr[len] == 0) continue;
        long long term = modPow((1LL * len * countArr[len] + 1), countArr[len]);
        answer = (answer * term) % MOD;
    }
    
    cout << answer << '\n';
    
    return 0;
}
